examples.chinese: 我爸爸五十歲，我媽媽四十八歲。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba wǔshí suì, wǒ māma sìshíbā suì.
examples.english: My father is fifty years old and my mother is forty-eight years old.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸喜歡吃飯，我媽媽喜歡吃麵。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba xǐhuān chī fàn, wǒ māma xǐhuān chī miàn.
examples.english: My dad likes to eat rice, my mom likes to eat noodles.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸、媽媽有三個孩子，我最愛看書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba, māma yǒu sān ge háizi, wǒ zuì ài kànshū.
examples.english: My parents have three kids. I like to read the most.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸每天早上都喝一杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba měi tiān zǎoshang dōu hē yì bēi kāfēi.
examples.english: My father drinks a cup of coffee every morning.

examples.chinese: 爸爸在客廳喝咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Bàba zài kètīng hē kāfēi.
examples.english: Dad is drinking coffee in the living room.

items.wordHook: 爸(father), said twice: 爸爸(dad).

examples.chinese: 媽媽把放在院子裡的一堆空瓶子、空罐子都扔了
剛剛大家推來推去的，結果把瓶子給打破了，這算誰的錯？

items.wordHook: 瓶(bottle) + 子(noun suffix) → a little bottle: 瓶子(bottle).

examples.chinese: 我要紅茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào hóngchá.
examples.english: Black tea please.

examples.chinese: 請問兩位要紅茶還是綠茶？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn liǎng wèi yào hóngchá háishì lǜchá?
examples.english: Would you like to have black tea or green tea?

examples.chinese: 請給我們一杯紅茶、一杯綠茶。請問一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒmen yì bēi hóngchá, yì bēi lǜchá. Qǐngwèn yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: We would to have a cup of black tea and a cup of green tea. How much does that cost altogether?

items.wordHook: 紅(red) + 茶(tea) → red tea, the Chinese name for black tea, from its red-colored brew.

examples.chinese: 我家附近有三條捷運線，一條紅的、一條綠的和一條藍的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu sān tiáo jiéyùn xiàn, yì tiáo hóng de, yì tiáo lǜ de hé yì tiáo lán de.
examples.english: There are three MRT routes near my place; the red one, the green one and the blue one.

examples.chinese: 元真，妳的這條裙子真好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, nǐ de zhè tiáo qúnzi zhēn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: Yuanzhen, your skirt is very beautiful; I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 妳看，這條黃色的褲子不錯吧？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè tiáo huángsè de kùzi búcuò ba?
examples.english: Look! This pair of yellow pants is nice, isn’t it?

examples.chinese: 很好看。這條藍的也很漂亮，藍色是今年很流行的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Hěn hǎokàn. Zhè tiáo lán de yě hěn piàoliang, lánsè shì jīnnián hěn liúxíng de yánsè.
examples.english: It is. This pair of blue pants is beautiful too. Blue is a popular color of this year.

examples.chinese: 這兩條我都去穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo wǒ dōu qù chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: I will try both on.

items.wordHook: a 亻(person) takes a light 攵(rap) to the 木(tree), stripping a branch → one 條(measure word for roads).

examples.chinese: 老師，國安今天要請假。他發燒了，不能來上課。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, Guó'ān jīntiān yào qǐngjià. Tā fāshāo le, bù néng lái shàngkè.
examples.english: Teacher, Guoan has to take a leave today. He has a fever and he can’t come to school.

examples.chinese: 他打電話跟我說，他不能來上課，請我幫他請假。
examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ diànhuà gēn wǒ shuō, tā bù néng lái shàngkè, qǐng wǒ bāng tā qǐngjià.
examples.english: He gave me a call and told me that he couldn’t make it to class and asked me to ask for a leave for him.

examples.chinese: 台北是一個又熱鬧又方便的城市。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi shì yī gè yòu rènao yòu fāngbiàn de chéngshì.
examples.english: Taipei is a city that is both lively and convenient.

examples.chinese: 我已經在台北住了三十年了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng zài Táiběi zhù le sānshí nián le.
examples.english: I have already lived in Taipei for thirty years.

examples.chinese: 山本良介要從台北車站搭捷運回去。
examples.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè yào cóng Táiběi Chēzhàn dā jiéyùn huíqù.
examples.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke wants to take the MRT back from Taipei Main Station.

examples.chinese: 除了台北101，你還去過哪些地方？
examples.pinyin: Chúle Táiběi 101, nǐ hái qùguo nǎxiē dìfāng?
examples.english: In addition to Taipei 101, what other places have you been to?

examples.chinese: 龍山寺是台北很有名的寺廟，廟裡常常有很多外國遊客。
examples.pinyin: Lóngshānsì shì Táiběi hěn yǒumíng de sìmiào, miào lǐ chángcháng yǒu hěn duō wàiguó yóukè.
examples.english: Longshan Temple is a very famous temple in Taipei; there are often many foreign tourists in the temple.

examples.chinese: 台北市在台灣的北部，有很多大樓。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi Shì zài Táiwān de běibù, yǒu hěn duō dàlóu.
examples.english: Taipei City is in northern Taiwan and has many tall buildings.

examples.chinese: 在台北市租房子太貴了，住在郊區可以省一點兒錢。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiběi shì zū fángzi tài guì le, zhù zài jiāoqū kěyǐ shěng yīdiǎnr qián.
examples.english: Renting a house in Taipei City is too expensive; living in the suburbs can save a little money.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾包花蓮當地的名產，要送給台北的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le jǐ bāo Huālián dāngdì de míngchǎn, yào sòng gěi Táiběi de péngyou.
examples.english: I bought several packs of Hualien's local specialties to give to my friends in Taipei.

examples.chinese: 這班車早上七點從台北出發，只停了三個站就到花蓮了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān chē zǎoshang qī diǎn cóng Táiběi chūfā, zhǐ tíng le sān ge zhàn jiù dào Huālián le.
examples.english: This train departs from Taipei at 7 a.m.; it stops at only three stations and then arrives in Hualien.

examples.chinese: 今年台北101跨年的人比去年增加了十萬人。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián Táiběi 101 kuànián de rén bǐ qùnián zēngjiāle shí wàn rén.
examples.english: The number of people at Taipei 101's New Year's Eve countdown this year increased by 100,000 compared to last year.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 台北101大樓的樣子看起來就像竹子一樣節節高升。
examples.pinyin: Táiběi 101 dàlóu de yàngzi kàn qǐlái jiù xiàng zhúzi yíyàng jiéjié gāoshēng.
examples.english: The appearance of the Taipei 101 building looks just like bamboo, rising higher section by section.

examples.chinese: 我請旅行社代訂從台北直飛美國的班機，機票較貴，但能節省不少時間。

items.wordHook: 台(Taiwan) + 北(north) → Taipei, the northern city of Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 什麼是十二生肖？
examples.pinyin: Shénme shì shí'èr shēngxiào?
examples.english: What is the Chinese animal zodiac?

examples.chinese: 原來是十二生肖，真的很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì shí'èr shēngxiào, zhēnde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: Oh! You are talking about the Chinese animal zodiac! It’s really interesting.

examples.chinese: 原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點兒不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎnr bù yíyàng.
examples.english: It turns out that the Vietnamese zodiac animals are a little bit different from the Chinese ones.

examples.chinese: 越南也有十二生肖，可是我們沒有兔年，有貓年。我是貓年出生的，屬貓。
examples.pinyin: Yuènán yě yǒu shí'èr shēngxiào, kěshì wǒmen méi yǒu tù nián, yǒu māo nián. Wǒ shì māo nián chūshēng de, shǔ māo.
examples.english: There are also zodiac signs in Vietnam, but we don’t have the year of the Rabbit; we have the year of the Cat. I was born in the year of the Cat, which means my zodiac animal sign is cat.

examples.chinese: 這是我朋友做的，因為他屬虎。妳知道十二生肖嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou zuò de, yīnwèi tā shǔ hǔ. Nǐ zhīdào shí'èr shēngxiào ma?
examples.english: This is the lantern that my friend made because his Chinese zodiac animal sign is tiger. Do you know the Chinese animal zodiac?

items.wordHook: The animal you resemble (肖) from your birth (生) year is your zodiac sign.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的小學教導孩子從平常生活中學習遵守規定。

items.wordHook: 中(middle) + 學(learn) → the middle stage of learning, so 中學 means high school.

examples.chinese: 我的同學住在我家旁邊，他也是我的鄰居。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngxué zhù zài wǒ jiā pángbiān, tā yě shì wǒ de línjū.
examples.english: My classmate lives next to my house; he is also my neighbor.

examples.chinese: 我烤了很多巧克力餅乾，用好看的紙包了一些送給鄰居。
每年春節時，爸爸都會送隔壁鄰居一盒蘋果，祝他們每天都平安、如意。
A:怎麼回事？外面怎麼這麼吵？ B:鄰居在修理屋頂，快修理好了，你忍耐一下吧。
A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
好幾個人都看到他跟這場火災有關，他不但不承認，反而說是鄰居做的。
鄰居有急事得出門處理，請我暫時幫他照顧孩子。
王伯伯最近很得意，到處告訴鄰居他兒子考上了全國最有名的大學。
當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
隔壁家的小子相當懂事，附近的鄰居們都很喜歡他。
李伯伯對做家事有很多妙主意，因此附近的鄰居常向他請教。
與鄰居建立友好的關係，能為你帶來很多好處。
牆上掛著的那張畫是我爸爸畫的。
examples.pinyin: Qiáng shàng guà zhe de nà zhāng huà shì wǒ bàba huà de.
examples.english: That painting hanging on the wall was painted by my dad.

examples.chinese: 這面牆壁上的圖畫真美，是誰畫的？
我沒有帶大門的鑰匙，不得不攀牆進去。
我想在床旁邊擺個書桌，不過空間不太夠，你可以幫我把床移到牆邊嗎？
我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: 我跟媽媽明天下午要一起去看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn māma míngtiān xiàwǔ yào yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: Mom and I are going to see a movie tomorrow afternoon.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我們一起去看海，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn hǎi, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: How about going to watch the sea this weekend?

examples.chinese: 我跟同學常常一起在學校打網球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué chángcháng yìqǐ zài xuéxiào dǎ wǎngqiú.
examples.english: My classmates and I often play tennis together at the school.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友常常一起去吃冰淇淋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī bīngqílín.
examples.english: My friends and I often go have ice cream together.

examples.chinese: 我們常常一起去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: We often go to the library together.

examples.chinese: 好啊，我們一起吃蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo ā, wǒmen yìqǐ chī dàngāo.
examples.english: Great, let’s eat the cake together.

examples.chinese: 昨天我們一起去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒmen yìqǐ qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: We went to the library together yesterday.

examples.chinese: 我今天七點起床。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: I get up at 7:00 today.

examples.chinese: 我週末還要工作，打算一下班就去看燈會。我們可以約友美一起去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhōumò hái yào gōngzuò, dǎsuàn yí xiàbān jiù qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen kěyǐ yuē Yǒuměi yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: I have to work on weekends, and plan to go to the Lantern Carnival as soon as I get off from work. We can ask Youmei out for the Lantern Carnival together.

examples.chinese: 好。我先回宿舍做功課，再跟你一起去找他。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo. Wǒ xiān huí sùshè zuò gōngkè, zài gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Okay. I will go back to the dormitory to do my homework first, then I will go to see him with you.

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

examples.chinese: 好，我們找時間一起去。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen zhǎo shíjiān yìqǐ qù.
examples.english: Okay, let’s make time for it.

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 打網球怎麼樣？中明說妳的網球打得很好，我們一起去打吧。
examples.pinyin: Dǎ wǎngqiú zěnmeyàng? Zhōngmíng shuō nǐ de wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ qù dǎ ba.
examples.english: How about playing tennis? Zhongming said you play it well. Let’s go play it together.

examples.chinese: 妳星期六下午有空嗎？我們一起去喝下午茶，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqí liù xiàwǔ yǒukòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù hē xiàwǔ chá, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Are you available on Saturday afternoon? How about we have afternoon tea together?

examples.chinese: 我們一起去買，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù mǎi, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: How about we go get them together?

items.wordHook: a 走(walk) takes the 己(self) up and out → ready to 起(rise).

公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。

examples.english: That foreign student often chats with Taiwanese friends, expressing his own opinions in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 那個外國學生常跟台灣朋友聊天，用中文表達自己的意見。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó xuéshēng cháng gēn Táiwān péngyǒu liáotiān, yòng Zhōngwén biǎodá zìjǐ de yìjiàn.
examples.english: That foreign student often chats with Taiwanese friends, expressing his own opinions in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 每個人的想法、看法都不一樣，要是遇到意見不同時，就應該好好地溝通。
開會時如果老闆突然變得很安靜，也不表達任何意見時，就表示他生氣了。
石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
國內外的社會運動，經常都是因為人民的意見不被尊重而引起的。
除非別人願意，否則你不該強迫其他人全按你的意見做事。
無論發生什麼事，她都會跟父母商量，並參考他們的意見。
我去義大利旅行的時候，不小心把護照弄丟了，我擔心死了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yìdàlì lǚxíng de shíhou, bù xiǎoxīn bǎ hùzhào nòngdiū le, wǒ dānxīn sǐ le.
examples.english: When I was traveling in Italy, I accidentally lost my passport; I was worried to death.

examples.chinese: 這個菜放了太多鹽，鹹死了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cài fàng le tài duō yán, xián sǐ le.
examples.english: This dish has too much salt in it; it's salty to death.

items.wordHook: 介(intermediary) + 紹(connect) → to introduce is to be the go-between who connects people.
When someone is busy (忙), you help (幫) them → 幫忙 means to help.
A 方(direction) sign points where a 人(person) stands at the ice: the ⺀(ice) marks the spot → 於(at).
A rushing current of mountain 氵(water) flows past the grand 京(capital), making the autumn air briskly 涼(cold).
Drenching droplets of 氵(water) seep deep into the soft dark 土(soil) until everything is 溼(wet).
a 石(stone) tablet rests beside the 馬(horse) post → one carved 碼(number).
網(net) + 址(location) → a location on the net: a web address.
要是 means 'if': you want (要) a situation to be (是) true, so you say 'if'.
Sharing thoughtful words of sincere 言(speech) that are proper and 宜(fitting) fosters harmony and deep bonds of lasting 誼(friendship).
A 貝(sea shell) is pressed onto a wall to 占(occupy) that spot, so it stays stuck there → 貼(stick).
A pocket drive you 隨(follow) carry on your 身(body) shaped like a small 碟(plate): 隨身碟 means USB flash drive.
a 麻(hemp) farmer ties a 幺(small) knot at the end of each rope → 麼(suffix).
黑(black) + 板(board) → blackboard, the board you write on in class.
